blindSourceSummaries: A major daily (14 April 2025) on the murder of a 32-year-old trans woman in a mid-sized city: beaten and thrown into a creek on 4 April 2025, onlookers filming instead of helping; the third killing of an LGBT+ person in that city that year and part of 13 trans people killed nationally in Q1 2025; the case triggered vigils in several cities. National-context source, not specific to this state/province.

A major news organisation's investigation (6 Aug 2025) documents the continuing wave of killings of queer and trans people in the country after the April 2025 murder, and the framing that in parts of the country being queer means 'to sign your own death sentence'. National-context source; mostly a video/interactive feature with limited extractable body text.

A foreign broadsheet (30 July 2024): trans women in the country targeted by armed groups - armed groups in an inland region circulated flyers threatening a 'social cleansing' of trans women as military targets; a trans woman with a salon was given a week to leave town; more than 40 trans women killed the previous year and 41 in 2023; armed-group displacement of trans women documented. National-pattern source relevant to intercity/border travel risk, not specific to this state/province.
